scope: Prospective molecular tests, not executable engine scenarios or achieved results

observed_subset.batch8: One shared P/R assembler: expression to component incorporation three seeds, full short G two seeds, full F renewal one seed
observed_subset.limitation: No membrane, long multigene capacity, stress sweep, calibrated energy or sustained replacement; XYZ isomer selectivity remains an optional design path
observed_subset.control_caution: Initially unlinked F can be expressed into an active tool; test subsequent state changes rather than assuming permanent noninteraction
observed_subset.batch9: 219 prepared L, selective diagnostic probes3/3 at150; rare local insertion1/3 and selected followup450; no real G/F or common membrane chemistry

campaign_contract.freeze: One alphabet, bond states, interactions, rates and external energy schedule per candidate
campaign_contract.initial_state: Constructed membrane, genes and tools allowed; track newly produced material separately
campaign_contract.perturbations: Add each non-target class then the full bath at 0.25x, 1x and 4x nominal concentration, with matched inert-crowding control
campaign_contract.observe: Wanted flux, wrong product bond states/sequences, sequestration time, leak, off-path aggregation, mass balance and resource depletion
campaign_contract.avoid: Do not forbid a collision by biological identity or infer harmlessness from no observed event
campaign_contract.provisional_screens: Target at least half the isolated useful flux after matched crowding correction and below 5% wrong incorporations; screening thresholds to declare before runs, not demonstrated performance or final viability criteria

tests.inputs: Same X/Y/Z/E bath; each prepared tool then all three
tests.require: Different assemblies under common laws favor N/A/L bond states respectively
tests.negative: No-tool and rearranged/scrambled tools; neither substrate loss nor random product counts as useful synthesis

tests.inputs: Three distinct genes, both monomer families and tools
tests.require: Each gene copied and each tool expressed, with ancestry; count chimeras and starvation
tests.negative: Single-gene reference plus each other gene, same total crowding and precursor inventory

tests.inputs: Prepared boundary at calculated radius; same local laws as free lipids
tests.require: Boundary contains target inventory without budding into preferred tiny rings
tests.negative: Existing V8 curvature and near-flat/soft-curvature variants compared explicitly

tests.inputs: Label newly made L analytically, initially inside a saturated prepared ring
tests.require: Actual incorporation into existing boundary and resealing, not adsorption or a new internal vesicle
tests.negative: No exchange; reversible contact exchange; add insertase only if simpler route fails with diagnostic

tests.inputs: Free X/Y/Z/E/W and bonded N/A plus polymers against the same boundary
tests.require: Feed supply and waste removal compatible with low leakage of compounds; all rates measured
tests.negative: Fixed primitive-only contact profiles; no dynamic inside/outside labels or particle teleportation

tests.inputs: Each active tool, accumulating product and W, L plus membrane
tests.require: Repeated turnover without coating genes/tools or permanent product binding
tests.negative: No affinity switch versus bond-occupancy release; no per-enzyme product identity shortcut

tests.inputs: Gene/protein fragments, unrelated polymers and wrong-state dimers
tests.require: Quantify recycling, resource traps and undesired templating while preserving targets
tests.negative: No turnover; same loss imposed on complete and incomplete chains

tests.inputs: Constructed cell with fixed food/fuel conditions and declared losses
tests.require: New genes, active tools and boundary material replace losses; all three tool roles retained
tests.negative: Disable each synthesis or energy input; count total extinction of a fragmented gene separately

tests.inputs: Required synthesis flux and measured permeability over actual boundary length
tests.require: Import, waste export and catalytic capacities jointly exceed measured demand
tests.negative: Spatially matched bath without membrane; identical external reservoir conditions

tests.purpose: Weak homeostasis: bounded functional stocks and recoverable perturbations
tests.inputs: Open constructed cell, fixed local feed/waste conditions, shortages/excesses and predefined loss perturbations
tests.require: All essential classes stay in declared viable bands, recover after perturbation and maintain material balance without irreversible loss or accumulation
tests.negative: Finite closed inventory exhaustion is not homeostasis; ablate proposed feedback or recycling, report extinction and censoring; never restore missing genes externally

checklist_link_scope: Planning coverage only, never proof of completed tests
